title: More control over generated media
summary:
Veo gained two-frame interpolation, MCP picked up a toolbox, and the app-submission path got easier to follow.

Veo can interpolate between a supplied first and last frame. Z-Image Turbo now generates at the requested resolution, up to its 2048-pixel dimension cap, instead of generating smaller images and upscaling them.

MCP v2 routes generation through the unified API and uses API keys in place of OAuth. Its new tools cover video, parallel image generation, image description, video analysis, transcription, web search, tool-calling chat, and model pricing.

Hello now sends generation and model requests directly to the unified API, retries rate-limited generations, and has a refreshed Pollen and tier layout. Community gained a tribute to active GitHub contributors; app submission links, a Reddit link, and API examples were updated. Two community-made apps joined the project listings, and the README news list was refreshed.

highlights.title: Choose Veo's last frame
highlights.text: Give Veo a first and last frame by passing two image URLs in `image`, separated by a pipe or comma. It generates video between them. [Explore the video API](https://gen.pollinations.ai/docs).

highlights.title: More tools for MCP
highlights.text: The MCP server now supports video generation, parallel image generation, image and video analysis, transcription, web search, tool-calling chat, and model pricing lookup. It connects with a Pollinations API key. [See the MCP docs](https://gen.pollinations.ai/docs#tag/mcp-servers).

highlights.title: Z-Image at requested resolution
highlights.text: Z-Image Turbo now generates directly at your requested resolution instead of making a smaller image and upscaling it, with dimensions capped at 2048. [Browse models](https://enter.pollinations.ai/models?q=z-image).

highlights.title: Meet the contributors
highlights.text: Hello's Community page now shows a tribute to active GitHub contributors, with profile links and commits from the past year. [Visit Pollinations](https://pollinations.ai).

highlights.title: Submit an app for Flower
highlights.text: The app-submission flow now checks for an Enter account, asks for fewer required fields, and can grant Flower tier when an eligible submission PR is marked for Flower and merged. [Explore the community](https://pollinations.ai).
